source.tamil_title: சிரிப்பு...... இதன் சிறப்பை சீர்தூக்கி பார்ப்பதே நமது பொருப்பு!...
source.authorship_evidence_basis: No item-level lyricist mapping is printed or established for song 4.

translation.english_title: Laughter... it is our responsibility to weigh its distinction

english_lines: Laughter...... its
Distinction—our responsibility is to weigh it and see!...
Whether one is dark or fair, to take it and
Show it—that is the mirror's distinction! This
Weeds the mind and drives away worry,
Giving the brain its liveliness,
Even in a life of sorrow, to discover joy—
That wonder is wrought by laughter! On the faces
Of people who take it as their companion,
A singular richness shines!
notes: The source's extended mirror/mind image is retained rather than reduced to a generic claim that laughter is healthy.
The verified source spelling `பொருப்பு` is not altered in Tamil; English renders the contextual sense as `responsibility`.

english_lines: Seeing a woman walking along the road,
To bare one's teeth in a grin is one kind of laughter; its
Immediate reward, received as a prize, is
An old slipper with its strap torn.
notes: The comic punishment image `காதறுந்த பழஞ் செருப்பு` is kept concrete as a strap-torn old slipper.

english_lines: A reserve belonging only to humankind, which knows how to think!—
Something other
Living creatures cannot perform—
This act called laughter!
This—the arrogant laughter of authorities!
This—the foolish laughter of one who walks submissively!
This—the daring laughter of conspirators!
This—musical laughter!
notes: The final catalogue of social types is kept as a sequence of pointed labels rather than smoothed into prose.

translator_notes: The social satire and concrete comic images are preserved directly.
